name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Progress across an ordered set of steps (a wizard, a multi-step form). Shows which are done (check), which is active (aria-current="step") and which are still ahead. Presentational: the parent owns `current` and what each step contains. Completed steps can be clickable to go back. Copy: step names are nouns, short and parallel, and they stay the same word in the step and in its page title.
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Stepper.json
